mentions.name: target-run
mentions.description: An npm-installable, platform-aware script runner for Node.js projects. Setting a package.json script body to `target-run` dispatches execution to platform/architecture-specific script variants (e.g. test:darwin:arm64, test:linux:x64) with a test:default fallback.
